newsitem.title: UK: ICO coffee arabica prices hit highest in 20 years.
newsitem.headline: ICO coffee arabica prices hit highest in 20 years.

text.p: The International Coffee Organization (ICO) said its 15-day average price of arabica coffee surged to a 20-year high of 325.98 cents a lb on Thursday, and up from 309.51 on Wednesday.
The price stood at 122.49 on January 2 this year.
The ICO also said its benchmark ICO composite daily indicator price rose further to touch 223.18 cents on Thursday, the highest level since January 1986. The indicator stood at 207.60 on Wednesday.
The ICO indicator is the average of weighted arabica and robusta prices from major markets.

New York arabica coffee futures have doubled since early this year to hit a new 20-year-high on mounting concerns over tight supplies from Central and South America and ahead of the frost season in Brazil.
New York's July contract sailed past the $3 a lb mark on Tuesday to hit a high of $3.18. -- Jalil Hamid, London Newsroom +44 171 542 4985
